outcome: Uptake and volume of permanent contraception (tubal ligation, vasectomy)
Uptake and volume of long-acting reversible contraception (LARC - intrauterine device, contraceptive implant)
cohort: Patients aged 15 to 55 who underwent permanent contraception or LARC placement at a multihospital system in northeast Ohio.
finding: The study found a 15.8% increase in total contraceptive procedures, with a significant rise in permanent contraception and vasectomies, following the Dobbs decision, and patients undergoing these procedures post-Dobbs were younger and more likely to report single relationship status.
